clips.title: The story
paras: The Etched Note is a formal summons directed to promising young tauren hunters in Camp Narache. Delivered on behalf of the trainer Lanka Farshot, the message calls the novice forward to begin mastering the practical and spiritual arts of the wild.

While training amidst the bluffs of Red Cloud Mesa, young tauren showing an aptitude for marksmanship and tracking are passed an etched message. Handed down through Grull Hawkwind, the note carries word that Lanka Farshot has taken notice of the youth's bloodline and raw capability, urging them to formalize their study beneath his watchful eye.

To the Shu'halo, a hunter is far more than a simple scout or warrior. Hunters sustain the tribes through their quarry, protect nomadic encampments, and live in close balance with the beasts of Kalimdor. By calling the novice into training, Lanka sets the groundwork for mastering weapons, understanding the creatures of Mulgore, and eventually undertaking the ancient art of taming wild companions.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, friend. I believe she was sent by the hunter trainer Lanka. If this note is from Lanka, I wouldn't take long in reading its contents.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Welcome to Camp Narache, friend. I hear good things about you. Your bloodline is strong, and many of the elders consider you skilled already. But that we will test.
The plains of Mulgore will be your home for sometime--you should do your best to learn it very well. One day you will travel to unfamilar lands to master greater skills. You must be ready.

clips.title: Completion
paras: And it is my job to make sure you are prepared by teaching you the basics of our profession—how to tame your pet, how to fire your rifle, and many other skills that will become necessary.
Hunters are a strong part of our tradition and history, friend. You would do well to remember how important you are to the tribe. You will be respected and revered if you serve our people well.
